item.title: MoneyPHP vs Brick Money vs Laravel Money in 2026: Which PHP Money Library Should You Use?
item.description: Every PHP developer eventually ships a rounding bug. It usually looks harmless: a cart total of 19.99 multiplied by 3, stored as a float, saved into a FLOAT column, and paid out a month later with a two-cent discrepancy that your accountant notices before you do. Money is not a number — it is an amount plus a currency plus a rounding policy — and PHP’s ecosystem has three serious libraries built around that fact.
